cues.en: An autoencoder is a specific type of deep learning model architecture that is being explored in interpretability
cues.zh: 自編碼器是一種特定的深度學習模型架構，正在可解釋性

cues.en: research as a way to identify latent factors that are embedded in the patterns across different neurons.
cues.zh: 研究中，用來辨識嵌入於不同神經元模式中的潛在因素。

cues.en: In this video, I will describe the architecture of the autoencoder and how it is used for interpretability.
cues.zh: 這支影片會介紹自編碼器架構，以及如何用於可解釋性。

cues.en: And then I'll switch to Python and show you how interpret autoencoders are set up, how they are trained,
cues.zh: 接著切換到 Python，示範自編碼器如何建立、如何訓練，

cues.en: and a few different ways of picking components to interpret and analyze.
cues.zh: 以及幾種挑選成分來解讀、分析的方法。

cues.en: In the code demo.
cues.zh: 這份程式示範，

cues.zh: 這有助於評估自編碼器表現，也方便

cues.zh: 批判性討論，解讀真實資料自編碼器時的一些挑戰。

cues.en: And in the next video, I'll show another code demo with an autoencoder in real LM data.

cues.zh: 再下一支，則透過程式挑戰，繼續探索。

cues.en: In this slide, I will give an overview of the big picture idea of using a sparse autoencoder to identify latent constructs.
cues.zh: 這張投影片，概述使用稀疏自編碼器辨識潛在構念的整體想法。

cues.en: So imagine we have this representation of a noun in an la.
cues.zh: 想像語言模型中，有名詞的這種表徵。

cues.en: Now we don't actually know how llms represent the concept of a noun.
cues.zh: 其實不知道，LLM 如何表徵名詞概念。

cues.en: Language models are not trained to know concepts like parts of speech.
cues.zh: 語言模型不是被訓練成知道詞性等概念，

cues.en: They do somehow learn it from next token prediction.
cues.zh: 但某種程度上，透過下一個 token 預測學會了。

cues.en: But the question is where is this concept actually stored in the LLM weights and how is it represented?
cues.zh: 問題是，這個概念實際存於 LLM 權重的哪裡，又如何表徵？

cues.en: Of course, a noun is a relatively simple latent concept in the context of AI safety.
cues.zh: 當然，名詞是相對簡單的潛在概念。在 AI 安全脈絡，

cues.en: You could replace this with a concept like deception or a willingness to participate in illegal or harmful activities.
cues.zh: 可以換成欺騙，或願意參與違法、有害活動等概念。

cues.en: Anyway, the concept of a noun is somehow embedded in the patterns of weights across the different transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 總之，名詞概念，以某種方式嵌入不同 Transformer 區塊之間的權重模式。

cues.en: So this is a latent variable.
cues.zh: 這是潛在變數，

cues.en: We cannot measure it directly.
cues.zh: 無法直接測量。

cues.en: However, we can design experiments to elicit manifest variables that we actually can measure.
cues.zh: 但可以設計實驗，引發真正能測量的顯現變數。

cues.en: For example, we can just present some tokens to the model and measure the activations in some embeddings
cues.zh: 例如，直接將一些 token 呈現給模型，再測量某些嵌入

cues.en: dimensions or some MLP neurons to the nouns in the text.
cues.zh: 維度、某些 MLP 神經元，對文字中名詞的活化。

cues.en: So these are our manifest variables.
cues.zh: 這些就是顯現變數。

cues.en: Next we apply some analysis, in this case a sparse autoencoder.
cues.zh: 接著套用分析，這裡是稀疏自編碼器。

cues.en: The idea is that we take all of our activations from our manifest variables and see if we can figure
cues.zh: 概念是，取得顯現變數的全部活化，看看能否找出

cues.en: out some clever way of combining all of their activations, so that all the information in these manifest
cues.zh: 某種巧妙方式，組合全部活化，也就是這些顯現變數中的全部資訊，

cues.en: variables, such that the combination of these activations using linear and nonlinear methods, leads
cues.zh: 使用線性與非線性方法，組合這些活化，得到

cues.en: to a set of latent components that are estimated from the manifest variables.
cues.zh: 一組從顯現變數估計的潛在成分。

cues.en: And actually, this high level overview on this slide basically works for any kind of latent model,
cues.zh: 其實，這張投影片的高階概述，基本上適用於任何潛在模型，

cues.en: including generalized eigendecomposition that I'll talk about in a few videos, and also like factor
cues.zh: 包括幾支影片後會談的廣義特徵分解，以及因素

cues.en: analysis, non-negative matrix factorization, etc., etc. lots of analyses could be plugged into this orange box here.
cues.zh: 分析、非負矩陣分解等等，很多分析都能放進這個橘色方框。

cues.en: But anyway, the question is that we start from some concept that we want to understand, some latent factor.
cues.zh: 但問題是，從一個想理解的概念、潛在因素開始，

cues.en: And what we get from our analysis is a set of components.
cues.zh: 分析得到的，卻是一組成分，

cues.en: These are statistical combinations of the activations of the manifest variables.
cues.zh: 是顯現變數活化的統計組合。

cues.en: Now ideally, one of these statistically reconstructed latent components actually maps onto the source
cues.zh: 理想上，其中一個統計重建的潛在成分，確實映射到

cues.en: latent construct that we are interested in.
cues.zh: 感興趣的原始潛在構念。

cues.en: But how do we know which of these latent variables corresponds to a representation of a noun that is really not trivial in the code demo.
cues.zh: 但如何知道，哪個潛在變數對應名詞表徵？這並不簡單。程式示範，

cues.en: In this video I will be simulating ground truth latent concepts.
cues.zh: 這支影片，會模擬有真值的潛在概念，

cues.en: So we will know for sure how to get the right answer.
cues.zh: 所以確定知道，如何找出正確答案。

cues.en: But in real data it's much more challenging.
cues.zh: 真實資料則困難得多。

cues.en: So maybe, for example, you can see which of these latent components has more activation for nouns compared to verbs and adjectives and so on.
cues.zh: 例如，可以看哪些潛在成分，對名詞的活化，比動詞、形容詞等更強。

cues.en: That's a good way to go about it, but it is one more layer of statistics that increases the amount of uncertainty and also needs to be evaluated carefully.
cues.zh: 這是不錯的方法，但又多一層統計，增加不確定性，也需要仔細評估。

cues.en: My point here is not that these statistically reconstructed components cannot be linked back to the latent construct that we're interested in.
cues.zh: 不是說，統計重建的成分，無法連回感興趣的潛在構念，

cues.en: Instead, my point is just that it can be challenging, especially with limited or noisy data.
cues.zh: 只是說，可能很有挑戰，尤其資料有限或有雜訊時。

cues.en: Okay, so now let me give you a little more detail about a sparse autoencoder.
cues.zh: 好，現在更詳細介紹稀疏自編碼器。

cues.en: Here you see a general overview of the architecture of an autoencoder.
cues.zh: 這裡是一般自編碼器架構的概覽。

cues.en: Each of these vertical blocks corresponds to or represents a different layer of the model.
cues.zh: 每個垂直區塊，對應、代表模型不同層。

cues.en: This corresponds to the input data into the model.
cues.zh: 這是模型的輸入資料，

cues.en: So in our case, the activation of 3000 MLP neurons elicited by a particular token.
cues.zh: 在這裡，就是某個 token 引發的 3,000 個 MLP 神經元活化。

cues.en: Then we have what's called the encoder layer.
cues.zh: 接著是所謂編碼器層，

cues.en: This is a pretty straightforward linear layer that transforms the input data using a feed forward operation with some non-linearity at the end.
cues.zh: 相當直接的線性層，利用前饋運算轉換輸入，末端再加一個非線性。

cues.en: And then in the middle, we have what is variously called the bottleneck or the latent, or the code layer of the model.
cues.zh: 中間則有不同名稱，瓶頸層、潛在層，或模型的編碼層，

cues.en: This is where the variables get transformed in the innermost layer.
cues.zh: 變數在最內層被轉換。

cues.en: And then we go to a decoder layer where the dimensionality of the data matches the dimensionality at the encoder layer.
cues.zh: 接著到解碼器層，資料維度與編碼器層匹配。

cues.en: In fact, autoencoder models will sometimes tie the encoder and decoder weights together so that the decoder is literally just the transpose of the encoder.
cues.zh: 其實，自編碼器有時會將編碼器與解碼器權重綁定，讓解碼器真的就是編碼器的轉置。

cues.en: That's not what I'm going to do in this video, but I will show you what that looks like in the next video.
cues.zh: 這支影片不會這麼做，但下一支會展示。

cues.en: And then finally we have the output of the autoencoder.
cues.zh: 最後是自編碼器輸出，

cues.en: Now this is always the same, or the size of this output is always the same as the size of the initial input.
cues.zh: 它永遠相同，或者說，輸出大小永遠與最初輸入相同。

cues.en: In fact, the entire goal of training an autoencoder is to get the output to match the input as closely as possible.
cues.zh: 其實，訓練自編碼器的全部目標，就是讓輸出盡可能符合輸入。

cues.en: So, for example, if there was just one linear layer in between input and output with no non-linearities,
cues.zh: 例如，如果輸入與輸出之間只有一個線性層，沒有非線性，

cues.en: then the model would just learn that the identity matrix is the optimal way to get the output to match the input.
cues.zh: 模型只會學到，單位矩陣是讓輸出符合輸入的最佳方式。

cues.en: But in these autoencoder architectures, the model needs to learn to transform the data with changing dimensionalities and also with non-linear transforms.
cues.zh: 但這種自編碼器架構，需要學習在維度改變、也有非線性轉換的情況下，轉換資料。

cues.en: So it's really not trivial to learn this input output mapping.
cues.zh: 所以學會輸入到輸出的映射，並不簡單。

cues.en: Now, in a typical autoencoder architecture that is used in, for example, data compression and image denoising.
cues.zh: 典型自編碼器，例如用於資料壓縮、影像去雜訊的架構，

cues.en: The latent layer is small, by which I mean it has a lower dimensionality than the input, and then
cues.zh: 潛在層很小，也就是維度低於輸入與

cues.en: the encoder layer that forces the model to learn a low dimensional representation, which is going to be more efficient than the full dimensional input.
cues.zh: 編碼器層，迫使模型學習低維表徵，比完整維度輸入更有效率。

cues.en: On the other hand, for sparse autoencoders, for example, the kinds we use in interpretability, we actually do the opposite.
cues.zh: 但稀疏自編碼器，例如可解釋性使用的類型，其實相反，

cues.en: We expand the dimensionality of the middle layer so that it's larger than the size of the input.
cues.zh: 會擴張中間層，讓它大於輸入。

cues.en: Now, you might think that that would lead to an overcomplete and redundant set of representations and transformations.
cues.zh: 你可能覺得，這會形成過完備、冗餘的表徵與轉換，

cues.en: But if you impose sparsity such that a lot of these activations are forced to be zero, then what ends
cues.zh: 但如果強制稀疏，讓許多活化為零，

cues.en: up happening is you get a relatively small number of units in this latent layer to be active, and a lot of the rest of them are zeros.
cues.zh: 最後就只有相對少量潛在層單元活躍，其餘大多為零。

cues.en: Now, it's not necessarily intuitively obvious that that would de-correlate the variables to identify
cues.zh: 直覺上，不一定明顯能理解，這如何讓變數解相關，辨識

cues.en: latent factors that are embedded in the patterns distributed across the manifest variables, but that
cues.zh: 分布在顯現變數模式中的潛在因素，

cues.en: is actually what ends up happening, at least under ideal conditions of a sufficient amount of clean data and separability in the data.
cues.zh: 但至少在資料足夠、乾淨、可分的理想條件下，確實會發生。

cues.en: The last thing I want to mention before telling you about the Python demo is the loss function.
cues.zh: 介紹 Python 示範之前，最後想談損失函數。

cues.en: As I already mentioned, the goal of training this model is to get the output to match the input as closely as possible.
cues.zh: 剛才提過，訓練目標，是讓輸出盡可能符合輸入。

cues.en: So the loss function is the difference of the input and the output, and partly because we don't care about whether the little discrepancies happen to be positive or negative.
cues.zh: 所以損失是輸入與輸出的差，部分原因是不在意微小差異是正或負，

cues.en: And also because squaring a loss function makes for a really simple derivative to calculate the input
cues.zh: 另外，損失平方後，導數很容易計算，因此輸入

cues.en: output derivative difference is squared and this is called mean squared error or MSE.
cues.zh: 與輸出之間的差會平方，稱為均方誤差，MSE。

cues.en: You will see that in the code in a few moments.
cues.zh: 稍後程式會看到。

cues.en: So here is the idea of the Python demo.
cues.zh: 這是 Python 示範的概念。

cues.en: I will start by simulating two latent sources that I will mix together to create the manifest variables.
cues.zh: 先模擬兩個潛在來源，混合起來，建立顯現變數。

cues.en: And this figure illustrates the idea of the simulations.
cues.zh: 這張圖，示範模擬的概念。

cues.en: So up here we have the two latent sources that I created.
cues.zh: 上面是我建立的兩個潛在來源，

cues.en: One is a sine wave and the other is just an alternating sequence of zeros and twos.
cues.zh: 一個是正弦波，另一個是零與二交替的序列。

cues.en: Here you see the histogram of the two latent variables.
cues.zh: 這裡是兩個潛在變數的直方圖。

cues.en: Here I mix them together to simulate the manifest variables that we can actually measure.
cues.zh: 這裡混在一起，模擬真正能測量的顯現變數，

cues.en: So these would be like the activations from two different embeddings dimensions in a language model.
cues.zh: 就像語言模型中，兩個不同嵌入維度的活化。

cues.en: And here you see the histograms of those two manifest variables.
cues.zh: 這裡則是兩個顯現變數的直方圖。

cues.en: And now the goal is going to be to see if we can train an autoencoder to transform these mixed manifest
cues.zh: 現在目標，是看看能否訓練自編碼器，將混合的顯現

cues.en: variables in such a way that the two original latent sources are separated in the autoencoder latent layer and identified.
cues.zh: 變數轉換，讓兩個原始潛在來源，在自編碼器潛在層分離並被辨識。

cues.en: Now, in this case, using simulated data for this demo is a real advantage because we literally have the ground truth right here.
cues.zh: 這份示範使用模擬資料，很有優勢，因為這裡真的有真值。

cues.en: So if we can get two latent variables from the autoencoder that look just like, or at least really
cues.zh: 如果從自編碼器得到兩個潛在變數，看起來就像，至少非常

cues.en: close to the blue dots and the green dots here, then we know that the procedure worked.
cues.zh: 接近這裡的藍點與綠點，就知道程序成功。

cues.en: So here you see an overview of the model architecture.
cues.zh: 這裡是模型架構概覽。

cues.en: I have an encoder and a decoder part.
cues.zh: 有編碼器與解碼器。

cues.en: Here in the forward method you can see that I take the input data x, push it through the encoder weights
cues.zh: forward 方法中，取得輸入 x，通過編碼器權重

cues.en: matrix, apply a jlu non-linearity, and then push that back through the decoder weights, and that gives me the output which I return.
cues.zh: 矩陣，套用 GELU 非線性，再送過解碼器權重，就得到傳回的輸出。

cues.en: I'm also going to return the latent variable activations because once the model is trained I want to analyze these latent variables.
cues.zh: 也傳回潛在變數活化，因為訓練完成後，要分析潛在變數。

cues.en: Now hopefully two of these latent variables will look like the original sources that I simulated here.
cues.zh: 希望其中兩個，看起來像這裡模擬的原始來源。

cues.en: By the way, in this case I used a hidden dimension of 20.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這裡用了 20 個隱藏維度，

cues.en: So there are 20 latent factors or estimated latent factors that this model will calculate.
cues.zh: 所以模型會計算 20 個潛在因素、估計的潛在因素。

cues.en: So this is really all there is to an autoencoder.
cues.zh: 這就是自編碼器的全部內容，

cues.en: It's pretty simple architecture.
cues.zh: 架構很簡單。

cues.en: But we want this to be a sparse autoencoder, which means that we need an L1 penalty term.
cues.zh: 但要成為稀疏自編碼器，就需要 L1 懲罰項。

cues.en: Of course, you are now highly familiar with L1 penalties and regularization, so I'm sure that this line of code here will look familiar to you.
cues.zh: 你已非常熟悉 L1 懲罰與正規化，相信這行程式很眼熟。

cues.en: I'm just taking the average of the absolute values of the latent activations and multiplying by this variable, which here I call sparsity weight.
cues.zh: 只取潛在活化絕對值的平均，乘以這個 sparsity weight 變數，

cues.en: But that would correspond to the parameter lambda that I discussed in the logistic regression a few videos ago.
cues.zh: 它對應前幾支影片邏輯斯迴歸中的 lambda。

cues.en: Now, this is not exactly the same thing as a lasso regularization, because that penalty term is based
cues.zh: 這與 Lasso 正規化不完全相同，因為後者的懲罰以

cues.en: on the coefficients, whereas here this is based on the activations which are data dependent.
cues.zh: 係數為基礎，這裡則是以取決於資料的活化為基礎。

cues.en: But it's a pretty similar idea.
cues.zh: 但概念相當相似，

cues.en: We are forcing the model to have some sparsity by having lots of zero valued activations.
cues.zh: 藉由大量零活化，迫使模型有稀疏性。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then I also included here another penalty term for the covariance across the different latent factors.
cues.zh: 這裡也加入另一個懲罰項，針對不同潛在因素之間的共變異數。

cues.en: I will explain this code and the math in a bit more detail when I switch to code.
cues.zh: 切換到程式碼後，會更詳細解釋程式與數學。

cues.en: I actually ended up not using this loss term here in this demo, but I do use it in the next couple of videos.
cues.zh: 這份示範，最後其實沒用這個損失項，但接下來幾支影片會用。

cues.en: But basically the idea is to encourage the latent variables to be weakly or not at all correlated with
cues.zh: 基本想法，是鼓勵潛在變數彼此弱相關，或完全不

cues.en: each other, to avoid having too much redundancy in the latent components estimated by the model.
cues.zh: 相關，避免模型估計的潛在成分有太多冗餘。

cues.en: So then I trained the model on the manifest variables, which are the mixed signals that I showed a moment ago in this screenshot over here.
cues.zh: 接著，對顯現變數訓練模型，也就是剛才截圖裡的混合訊號。

cues.en: So here you see the two losses.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到兩個損失，

cues.en: And yeah in general the total loss goes down.
cues.zh: 一般而言，總損失下降，

cues.en: And that looks quite nice.
cues.zh: 看起來很好。

cues.en: Interestingly the L1 loss kept actually increasing for a bit before it started settling down.
cues.zh: 有意思的是，L1 損失持續上升一段時間，才開始穩定。

cues.en: By the way, note that the L1 and the MSE losses are on very different scales, and so in this graph they have their own separate y axes.
cues.zh: 注意，L1 與 MSE 的尺度非常不同，所以圖中使用獨立 y 軸。

cues.en: Here you see the correlation matrix of all the latent variables that were estimated in the middle layer the latent layer of the autoencoder.
cues.zh: 這是自編碼器中間層、潛在層，估計出的全部潛在變數相關矩陣。

cues.en: In general there are some pretty strong correlations among the different pairs of latent variables.
cues.zh: 一般而言，不同潛在變數配對之間，有些相當強的相關。

cues.en: You can see that a lot of the block elements are either 1 or -1.
cues.zh: 許多區塊元素，是 1 或 −1，

cues.en: So that is the idea here.

cues.en: You would just need to make this thing be a PyTorch tensor.

cues.zh: 我只是懶得多打那些字。

cues.zh: 好，接著我從共變異數矩陣中減掉這個。

cues.zh: 基本上，這個操作會取共變異數矩陣，

cues.en: It leaves all of the off diagonal terms preserved and it obliterates it, zeros out all of the diagonal terms which are the variances.
cues.zh: 保留所有非對角元素，並消除、歸零所有對角元素，也就是變異數。

cues.en: And then basically I just square all of those and sum that matrix.

cues.en: So what this does is give me, uh, larger values when the covariance is across the different, uh, estimated components.

cues.zh: 也就是自編碼器模型內部潛在成分的共變異數很大時，得到的值就會比較大。把它當作懲罰

cues.zh: 項使用，就會鼓勵模型降低非對角的共變異數，也就是鼓勵
